choices.A: It has an origin and a unit length, but no specified positive direction.
choices.B: It has an origin and a positive direction, with 1 and 2 marked to the right of the origin. The distance from 0 to 1 is 1 cm, and the distance from 1 to 2 is 2 cm.
choices.C: It has an origin and a positive direction, with 1, 2, and 3 marked in order to the right of the origin. The distance between each pair of adjacent points is 1 cm.
choices.D: It has a positive direction and a unit length, but no specified origin.

question: Which of the lines described below is a number line?
solution: A number line must have an origin, a positive direction, and a consistent unit length. Only the line with an origin, a positive direction, and 1 cm spacing between 1, 2, and 3 meets all the requirements.
